data.narrative:
ABL Bio is a public company listed on KOSDAQ in the Biotech & Health sector. The valuation universe comprises 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 7 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, and Freenome.

Two standard triangulation methods were evaluated. Peer-median analysis was not applicable: while 7 same-sector private peers exist, none satisfied narrow filters for stage, adjacency, or valuation tier, falling below the minimum 3-datapoint threshold required for reliable median estimation. Public-comp anchoring could not be applied because ABL Bio's revenue is not on file—a common limitation for private company datasets—and without this metric, the 8.1x price-to-sales median observed across the three public comparables cannot be meaningfully applied.

The analysis does not support a quantified valuation range at this time. The company's $5B+ in cumulative capital raised (IPO plus licensing) provides directional context on investor conviction but does not substitute for comparable-based pricing. Key uncertainties precluding valuation include the absence of disclosed revenue, the lack of sufficient narrow-tier peers meeting statistical thresholds, and limited visibility into the company's current operational metrics. A credible range would require either revenue disclosure or identification of additional same-stage private comparables with disclosed valuations.
